author: Enkim
text: FL is no more when the price breaks its edge and makes an engulf. Then new FL is formed after price do its retrace and hit its target (another FL in opposite direction). If price does not engulf FL, then it is valid and can be valid for many years till the price comes to it again. Try to be very precise in drawing rectangles, because you need to see when it is engulfed. UPL and LFL are the most important FLs because they can hold the price, and you can chain them if you draw them correctly and very well use them to predict the future bounce. As for your last picture, i didnt look at it closer but if you want to draw FL after break of that low (or FL low was reacting to) the correct one is this:
